dod_intent_evidence: None — this is a commercial enterprise identity-governance/IGA SaaS platform (customers named: Pinterest, GitHub, Roku); the three news hits are false-positive matches for an unrelated DARPA program also named LUMOS (Lasers for Universal Microscale Optical Systems, run by Nexus Photonics/AIM Photonics), not this company.
what_they_do: An AI-agent-driven identity governance and access management (IGA) SaaS platform for enterprise IT — reviews, provisions, and revokes access for humans, machines, and AI agents.
